name: GIMO
tagline: 217 motion trajectories, 11 subjects, 19 scanned indoor scenes: 129K HoloLens2 ego frames with 3D eye gaze and inertial-mocap SMPL-X bodies.

annotations.format: CSV (dataset index, head/hand/eye poses), PKL + OBJ (SMPL-X per frame), PLY (gaze point clouds), BVH (raw mocap), JSON (transforms)
annotations.coverageNote: Every sequence ships SMPL-X poses, synchronized HoloLens2 gaze and a scanned scene mesh; access is by signed agreement (encrypted download).

hand_pose.note: Noitom suit records hand joints; SMPL-X fits include hands

body_pose.note: SMPL-X per frame (VPoser latent + orient/trans) from 96 fps inertial mocap

scene_3d.note: LiDAR-scanned textured OBJ + downsampled PLY per scene

annotations.sample:
